statement: Each controller and, where applicable, the controller's representative must maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility with the contents listed in Article 30(1)(a)-(g); the obligation does not apply to an enterprise or organisation employing fewer than 250 persons unless the processing it carries out is likely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, the processing is not occasional, or the processing includes special categories of data under Article 9(1) or personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences under Article 10 (GDPR Article 30(1), (5)).
caveat: Processors carry a parallel record duty (Art. 30(2)), the record must be in writing, including in electronic form, and be made available to the supervisory authority on request (Art. 30(3)-(4)), and the Article 30(5) derogation's conditions each independently revive the duty, so regular production processing of customer data typically stays in scope. Verified against the Official Journal text on the Publications Office cellar (eur-lex.europa.eu was unreachable to automated fetches at check time). This repo does not determine whether the derogation applies.
